description: This file contains the source code for the Cart class within the OpenCart system, specifically in the namespace Opencart.Catalog.Controller.Common. It defines various methods related to cart operations such as viewing the cart, removing products, and vouchers, and generating cart-related views for the frontend.

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: Controller class handling shopping cart display, update, and deletion actions within the OpenCart system.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates the cart view page with current cart contents, totals, and links for removal.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns the cart overview by calling the index method.

methods.name: removeProduct
methods.description: Removes a specified product from the cart and returns a JSON response indicating success or error.

methods.name: removeVoucher
methods.description: Removes a voucher from the cart and returns a JSON response indicating success or error.
